# Wipefest Zor'lok reference fixture

`reference_fight.json` is the full response captured from:

```text
https://api.wipefest.gg/report/j8wDLpCTaqhB7M1x/fight/10?markupFormat=Markup&group=1507&insightsOnly=false
```

The payload is retained without redaction or shape reduction so changes to the
Wipefest response contract remain visible to tests. The report code, fight ID,
group ID, actor IDs, and names therefore remain the captured values; no identity
mapping or transformation has been applied. Derived raid/player contexts are
separate golden files generated by `app.pull_coach.wipefest_context` and are not
substitutes for the full source snapshot.

When updating the fixture after a Wipefest contract change, replace the full
response and deliberately review `test_wipefest_context.py` golden contexts and
`test_wipefest_openrouter_discord_e2e.py` contract/provenance assertions.
